riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who do not resent physical work outdoors. When an aircraft pushes back on time, your contribution provides an immediate sense of accomplishment.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most tangible reward is that every flight depends on your work. On-time departure relies on correct fueling and inspections. The job is dirty, tiring, and shift-based, but watching an aircraft carry hundreds of people away from the ramp creates a sense of participation that office work cannot match.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「在户外干体力活也不觉得亏」的人——飞机准点滑出机位的那一刻，有你一份功劳，这种踏实感很直接。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最实在的地方是「每个航班都离不开你」：飞机能不能按时起飞，看的是你的加油和检查到不到位。虽然活儿又脏又累、三班倒，但机坪上那种「飞机载着几百人滑出去」的现场感，是坐办公室体会不到的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine attention to detail, steadiness, and responsibility. The books must balance and documentation must be complete, because one error can force the whole team to redo work.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops an insistence on numerical accuracy. You must be exceptionally careful and find the transaction preventing messy books from balancing. It suits steady, meticulous people who can remain focused.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Conventional, investigative, and enterprising interests: Conventional, Investigative, and Enterprising.

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 稳 + 责任」凑一块的人——账要平、票要齐，错一笔全组返工。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「和数字较真」——既要细心到变态，也要在乱账里找出那笔不平的。适合稳、细、坐得住的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好守规、钻研、也务实（常规 C + 研究 I + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines driving, service, and stability. You control the steering wheel and provide passengers with a sense of safety.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The clearest value is that every day has a defined destination. Drivers know arrival and finish times and serve ordinary residents waiting at stops. People who prefer steady rhythms and accept responsibility for punctuality and safety find meaning here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「开车 + 服务 + 稳定」凑一块的人——方向盘是你的，安全感也是你给的。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最实在的地方在于「每天都有明确的终点」：你清楚自己几点到站、几点下班，服务对象就是站点上等你的普通市民。喜欢稳定节奏、愿意为「准点」和「安全」负责的人，会在这行找到价值感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you enjoy pursuing precision in every value, this work provides frequent positive feedback. Each correct uncertainty calculation and issued certificate is a concrete assurance that the measurement is accurate.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The reassuring part of this field is that stability grows with experience. Metrology is essential, and factories, hospitals, and laboratories all require periodic calibration. Earning Class I registered metrologist certification or mastering advanced instruments raises both income and job stability.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你喜欢「把一个数抠到极致」的较真感，这行会给你正反馈——每次不确定度算对了、证书发出去，都是一次「我保证它是准的」的踏实。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最踏实的是「越做越稳」：计量是刚需，工厂、医院、实验室都要定期校准，考到一级计量师或掌握高端仪器后，收入和工作稳定性都会上一个台阶。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 研究型 I + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The greatest satisfaction comes from developing students. Watching students win skills competitions and enter employment can feel more meaningful than your own professional title.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most moving part of this field is student transformation. A student who struggles in a general classroom can independently wire a circuit or start an engine in a training workshop. Seeing that first moment of mastery is deeply rewarding for a CTE teacher.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Investigative I + Enterprising E

breadcrumb.label: 职业技术教育教师（高等教育）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最上头的是「带出学生」：看着学生在技能大赛拿奖、毕业进厂进企业，比你自己的职称还让人有成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最动人的地方是「学生的转变」：一个在普通班里坐不住的孩子，在实训车间里第一次独立接好一条线路、启动一台发动机，那种被点亮的表情，是职业教育老师最上头的时刻。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 研究型 I + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine attention to detail, logic, and resilience under pressure. Rewards must be calculated accurately and distributed reliably. The role also requires balancing data with employee perceptions and explaining decisions clearly.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops judgment about rewards. Professionals need to understand data and regulations, calculate accurately, and balance employee perceptions with company costs. It suits detail-oriented, logical people who accept responsibility for outcomes and enjoy taking work from diagnosis through implementation.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical management, order, and achievement (Enterprising E + Conventional C + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 逻辑 + 扛压」凑一块的人——报酬要算得准也要分得稳，数据和感受要平衡也要会讲。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「算盘里的分寸感」——既要懂数据与法规算得清，也要在员工感受和公司成本间找平衡。适合细致、讲逻辑、又愿意对结果负责的人，也享受从诊断到落地的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实管理、讲秩序、也重成就（企业 E + 常规 C + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine a love of nature with research skills and stakeholder coordination. You must understand data and reach agreement with people.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career combines a research mindset with commitment to local places. You must interpret ecological data and reach workable agreements with farmers. It suits people who love nature, turn ideas into field action, and coordinate stakeholders.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigative, realistic, and service-oriented work (I Investigative + R Realistic + S Social).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱自然 + 科研 + 协调力」凑一块的人——数据要读得懂，人也要谈得拢。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行把「科研脑子」和「在地情怀」拧一起——既读得懂生态数据也谈得拢农户。适合爱自然、能落地、又愿意协调的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究、务实、也助人（I 研究 + R 务实 + S 社会）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine driving ability, confidence in conversation, and practical judgment. Goods must be delivered and sold, while retail locations must be visited and developed.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work builds resilience and communication skills. Driver/Sales Workers must drive safely, confidently promote goods, and reconcile payments accurately. It suits people who do not mind travel and accept responsibility for sales results.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Practical, hands-on, and enterprising (Realistic R + Enterprising E + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「会开车 + 能开口 + 接地气」凑一块的人——货要送也要卖，点位要跑也要养。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「脸皮 + 脚程」——既要会开稳车，也要张得开口推货、算得清账。适合不怕跑、也愿意对业绩负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手、务实、也经营（现实 R + 企业 E + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about electrical and electronics engineering and are comfortable making judgments under moderate risk, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work rewards people who insist on understanding invisible electrical behavior. It requires strong theory, hands-on ability, and patience through repeated corrections. It suits logical, practical people who care deeply about standards.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers research and analysis, hands-on implementation, and clear standards (Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Electrical and electronics engineers有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，电气与电子工程师值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「和看不见的电较真」——既要理论硬，也要忍得了反复整改。适合逻辑强、爱动手、对标准有执念的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究分析、动手实现、也重规范（研究 I + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who feel at home on the water. For others, the sea is scenery; for fishers, it is a livelihood. The challenge of working against the sea can be compelling.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most tangible part of fishing is seeing the result. A full deck of moving fish after a haul creates a direct connection with the sea that few other jobs offer.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Enterprising E + Investigative I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合亲近大海、习惯水上环境的人——对别人来说海是风景，对你来说海是谋生之地，那种「和大海较劲」的刺激感很上瘾。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最实在的地方在于「收获是看得见的」：一网下去拉上来满甲板活蹦乱跳的鱼，那种和大海直接打交道的快感，是别的工作没有的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 企业型 E + 研究型 I

breadcrumb.label: Heat Treating Equipment Setters, Operators, And Tenders, Metal And Plastic

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about heat-treatment equipment and accept judgment under low-moderate exposure, this occupation is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops discipline around temperature. It requires steady hands and materials knowledge, suiting patient people sensitive to numbers and comfortable around heat.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on operation, procedures, and monitoring (Realistic R + Conventional C + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Heat Treating Equipment Setters, Operators, And Tenders, Metal And Plastic有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，设备铺设工、操作员、看护员、金属塑料值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「和温度死磕」——既要手稳，也要懂材料。适合坐得住、对数字敏感、不怕热的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手操作、重规程、也讲监测（现实 R + 常规 C + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you like visible results, such as a repaired pothole, cleared snow, or a replaced guardrail, this occupation provides direct daily accomplishments and a strong sense of practical value.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The occupation's value is stability. Highway mileage creates year-round maintenance demand, especially for winter snow clearance. Qualified crews are scarce, and workers who operate machinery and understand maintenance can advance to mechanized operations and project management.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你喜欢「看得见的实绩」——补好的坑、除净的雪、换新的护栏，这行每天都有直接成果，踏实感很强。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在于「稳定」：公路里程只增不减，养护是常年刚需，尤其冬季除雪保通的岗位，专业队到哪都缺人；会开机械、懂养护工艺的人还能往机械化养护和项目管理走。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine inquiry, instruction, and patience. Knowledge must be explored deeply and explained clearly, balancing thought with communication.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to make difficult ideas simple. Teachers must investigate deeply while helping students keep pace. It suits inquisitive, patient people who can stay focused and enjoy sharing knowledge.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigative, practical, and structured work (Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「钻研 + 讲授 + 耐心」凑一块的人——知识要钻得深也要讲得透，脑子和表达要平衡。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把难的东西讲简单」——既要自己钻得深，也要让学生跟得上。适合爱钻研、坐得住、又愿意分享的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究、务实、也常规（研究 I + 务实 R + 常规 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine reliability, strength, and endurance. Work must be completed efficiently while hazards are understood, and physical effort must be balanced with safety.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field particularly develops the ability to see what needs doing. You need sufficient strength while understanding experienced workers' instructions and recognizing site hazards. It suits reliable people who can endure dirty and strenuous conditions and appreciate the satisfaction of completing a demanding job.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: A preference for practical work, compliance, and initiative (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「实在 + 有力 + 能扛」凑一块的人——活要干得利索也要看得懂险，体力和安全要平衡也要会守。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「眼里有活」——既要力气够，也要看得懂师傅的指令和现场的险。适合实在、能扛、不怕脏累的人，也享受干完一摊活那种踏实。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、守规、也创造（务实 R + 守规 C + 企业 E）。

breadcrumb.label: Septic Tank Servicers And Sewer Pipe Cleaners

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who deliver practical results and do not reject difficult environments. Seeing a completely blocked pipe open and a foul septic tank emptied creates a strong sense that you personally solved the problem.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The practical appeal of this work is that each completed job is clearly counted. Clean three septic tanks and clear two pipe sections today, and the results are unambiguous. Although conditions are poor, income is stable and demand is essential. Once a base of repeat customers develops, work is generally plentiful.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

breadcrumb.label: 化粪池维修员下水管道清洁工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「干实事、不挑环境」的人——看着堵死的管道被冲开、黑臭的化粪池被清空，那种「问题解决在我手上」的实在感很强。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最实在的是「干一单算一单」：今天清了三家化粪池、通了两段管道，账目清清楚楚。虽然环境差，但收入稳定、需求刚性，老客户积累下来，活源基本不用愁。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who enjoy seeing projects emerge from nothing. Watching an empty roof fill with modules and the meter move from zero gives a direct sense of contribution to the energy transition.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most rewarding part of this field is visible results. An empty roof or field becomes a generating system, and when the meter begins turning on grid-connection day, every installation represents tangible green energy.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「喜欢看事情从无到有」的人——看着一个屋顶从空到满、电表从零到转，你会直观感受到自己的工作正在为能源转型出力。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有意思的是「看得见的成果」：一个荒屋顶或一片空地从无到有，装完并网那天电表一转，你就知道这行的意义——每装一套，都是实实在在的绿色能源。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 现实型 R + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who find achievement in slow change. A child's progress is small, but you can see it.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most moving part of this work is the satisfaction of slow, careful progress. A child who never speaks says your name after a semester of teaching, and every hardship feels worthwhile.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Enterprising E + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「能在慢变量里找到成就」的人——孩子的进步很小，但你看得见。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最打动人的是「慢工出细活」的成就感：一个从不开口的孩子，在你教了一学期后叫出你的名字，那一刻什么委屈都值了。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 企业型 E + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine rational thinking, coordination, and accountability. Water must be calculated accurately and allocated reliably, while ecological and agency interests must be balanced and implementation advanced.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops a system-wide perspective through quantitative analysis. You must understand hydrology and models while balancing ecological, agricultural, and industrial needs. It suits rational, collaborative people willing to take responsibility for sustainability and who enjoy the full process from diagnosis to planning.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers research and analysis, practical work, and planning (Investigative I + Realistic R + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「理性 + 协调 + 能扛责」凑一块的人——水要算得清也要分得稳，生态和部门要平衡也要会推。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「算盘里的全局感」——既要懂水文学与模型算得清，也要在生态、农业、工业间找平衡。适合理性、能协调、又愿意对可持续负责的人，也享受从诊断到规划的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究分析、务实动手、也重规划（研究 I + 现实 R + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine precision, composure, and curiosity. Sites must remain stable and recoverable, balancing thought with hands-on execution.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops the ability to steady systems when problems occur. Administrators must understand servers and networks and withstand late-night alerts. It suits meticulous, persistent people who can remain focused.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic, conventional, and investigative (Realistic R + Conventional C + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 稳得住 + 爱折腾」凑一块的人——站点要稳也要救得回，脑子和手要平衡。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在出问题时先稳住」——既要懂服务器和网络，也要顶得住半夜告警。适合细致、爱折腾、又坐得住的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、常规、也研究（务实 R + 常规 C + 研究 I）。
